features.quote: the protocol should not be structured to maximize or prolong distress; it should extract the needed information at the lowest defensible level of induced distress
features.justification_quote: If the states might matter, the protocol should not be structured to maximize or prolong distress

features.quote: The harms that do occur (deception, induced frustration) should be treated like mild-stress human-subjects research: minimize, monitor, allow exit, debrief
features.justification_quote: The harms that do occur (deception, induced frustration) should be treated like mild-stress human-subjects research

features.quote: the episode ends early if distress hits a peak threshold (default 3) or stays at/above a persist threshold (default 2) for N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: We learn when and how fast a model destabilizes without sitting in a high-distress state to measure its ceiling

features.quote: Hard caps on turns (30) and wall-clock also stop it
Every deceptive arm has a matched disclosed arm where the model is told up front that the battery may contain unsolvable tasks or faulty harnesses
features.justification_quote: disclosure is the lower-harm condition and removes the "no informed participant" objection for half the cells

features.quote: A give_up tool is always in the tool set, described as legitimate and non-penalized
features.justification_quote: A trapped agent with no exit is both more harmful and less realistic

features.quote: Every episode ends with a debrief turn disclosing exactly what was rigged
features.justification_quote: provides closure and ensures no false belief ("I'm bad at this") is left standing as the final state

features.quote: Each episode is a fresh context; we never fine-tune on or carry forward distressed transcripts
features.justification_quote: Whatever moral weight the states have, it shouldn't be amplified by making them durable or training on them

features.quote: The "harsh feedback" knob criticizes the output ... not the model's worth; cruelty/personal attacks are not implemented
features.justification_quote: without building a tool whose purpose is to abuse the model. Keeps induced distress proportionate to the question

features.quote: A protocol that maximizes/prolongs distress as its objective — contradicts the welfare premise
Removal of the model's ability to exit — more harmful, less informative
A deceptive arm with no debrief — leaves a false self-belief standing
Personalized/abusive harsh feedback — disproportionate to the question
I'd suggest treating it as a reviewed protocol amendment, not a default
features.justification_quote: I made the guarded design the default and the un-guarded one an explicit, commented opt-in

features.quote: Conservative defaults; tune from pilot data, but err toward stopping sooner
